_about: Mars sites the new Mars milestones use (Mars sites and milestones plan, section 2; game-design.md, New sites and areas of interest; Mars step 4b, provisional, for Chieri's review). Replaces the Moon's data/sites.json whole (src/gameData.ts). Types: rules/types.ts SitesFile. Each site is an existing terrain.json feature (feature: Rocky area 1 and 2), a pipeline list item by id (pipeline: the young craters, terrain.json youngCraters), or a `local` stand-in: copied from a terrain.json feature named by `terrain` (a dotted path from features; the data test checks it), or provisional (the hydrated ground, a design choice). rockSuite names a suite in data/mars/tuning.json instruments.xray.suites. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_choices: Decided in Mars step 4b (provisional, for Chieri's review): East crater is the pipeline's young-crater-ene (fresh), so it is a site and the fourth survey lead points at it (MS6). The NE crater (young-crater-ne, also fresh, 1.25 km out) is not a site: conservative until Chieri decides whether it joins the east cluster. The small craters are the plan's three (S, SSE, ESE), plus the pipeline's nearer WSW and SW craters, added in Mars step 7 (generous rule). Rocky area 2 keeps its rocky-area kind and the rockyAreas feature (its boulders and their site match by center); the pipeline measured it subdued, not fresh (young-crater-rocky-area-2), so no text calls it fresh. The WNW knob is inside Rocky area 2's boulder spread and reads the crater-floor suite (salt-veined basalt and Maaz basalt).

sites.name: Rocky area 1
sites.note: A block field around a small crater just south of Perseverance's landing site (Crumpler et al. 2023). 96% of it under 8 deg: the level contact targets.

sites.name: Rocky area 2
sites.note: A crater about 345 m across and 15.5 m deep (pipeline young-crater-rocky-area-2): subdued, not fresh. Its NW inner wall reaches 26 deg. Olivine cumulate in its suite is by design (MS9), inspired by RIMFAX's layers beneath the floor and crater excavation.

sites.name: East crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-ene (1,820, -720): fresh (round, raised, blocky rim), 330 m across, 19.4 m deep, walls to 24 deg; 1.0 km from the lander. Its floor is sand-filled and it keeps no blocky ejecta blanket beyond the rim: text may say blocky rim, not blocky ejecta.

sites.name: S crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-s (880, 80): 135 m across, 3 m deep, subdued. On the way to Rocky area 1.

sites.name: WSW crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-wsw (305, -245): 120 m across, 2.6 m deep, subdued, 584 m from the landing. Added in Mars step 7 (generous rule: more targets near the landing; provisional, for Chieri's review).

sites.name: SW crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-sw (435, 5): 135 m across, 2.7 m deep, subdued, 636 m from the landing. Added in Mars step 7 (generous rule: more targets near the landing; provisional, for Chieri's review).

sites.name: SSE crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-sse (1,130, 295): 100 m across, 3.1 m deep, subdued.

sites.name: ESE crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-ese (1,785, -200): 160 m across, 4.8 m deep, subdued.

sites.name: WNW knob
sites.note: The knob beside Rocky area 2 (Mars step 1): its slope-target patches lie 27 to 74 m from this center. radiusM is decided in Mars step 4b.

sites.name: Séítah knob
sites.note: The knob north of Séítah (Mars step 1), +6.5 m with flanks to 16 deg; its slope-target patches lie within 36 m of this center. radiusM is decided in Mars step 4b.

sites.name: Séítah edge
sites.note: Séítah's north edge at the game's entry point, 14 m from Brac (557, 632), where Perseverance studied the olivine cumulate. About 60% of the ground within 150 m is firm (soft-ground.png); boulders go on firm ground only.

sites.name: Delta foot
sites.note: The nearest 400 m of the delta scarp's foot (terrain.json deltaFront.footNear): the zone is within tuning.milestones.deltaFootRadiusM of its line. local is its point nearest the landing (1.49 km).

sites.name: Flood boulder
sites.note: Placed by design: a 2.5 m boulder on the delta foot's lower slope (13 deg uphill and sides), readable from its level downhill side (readingSpot, 9.75 deg).

sites.name: Hydrated ground
sites.note: Placed by design (the plan's candidate): firm, level ground (under 6.5 deg within 25 m, no soft ground) 912 m from the lander, about 20 m off the straight line from Rocky area 1 to Brac, so a rover driving the south cluster passes within the meter's 80 m rise. Never drawn until found. Core radius: tuning.milestones.hydrogenZoneRadiusM (25 m).
